messages: Taylor Reed: Noticed a few compliance nits in the Security & Data tab. Main one: the retention control is just 'Retention' which is ambiguous in audits and screenshots. Also region shows 'eu-central' but no indication it's org-enforced, users assume editable. Priya Nair: Strong +1 on making retention explicit. Proposal: label = 'Data retention period (days)' and show presets 30 / 90 / 365 with a 'Custom' option. For presets, show a tooltip: 'Common retention settings'. Omar Khalid: UX for enforced region: add a lock icon with accessible name and keyboard focus. Tooltip text: 'Enforced by org policy 123 124' (replace with policy ID). Avoid ambiguous copy like 'locked' alone. Ellen Wu: KMS label nit: current string 'Enable KMS' is vague. Suggest 'Use customer-managed encryption keys (KMS)'. For the toggle use role="switch" and aria-describedby that references a short note with the audit phrasing. AccessibilityBot: Quick checklist: - toggle: role="switch" + aria-checked - enforcement badge: tabindex="0" + aria-label - retention presets: use radiogroup when only presets are allowed - tooltip: role="tooltip" and aria-hidden toggled when not visible Taylor Reed: Good checklist. Also for audit logs, please include actor, action, target, and context. Example: 'Priya Nair set data retention to 90 days (previous: 30 days)'. That helps compliance investigations. Priya Nair: Agree. Also add key-id to KMS events: 'Ellen Wu enabled customer-managed keys (key-id: abc-123)'. Keep wording past tense for events. Omar Khalid: Visual a11y: the lock badge uses gray-400 on white which is low contrast for low-vision users. Suggest `--token-badge-foreground: #0b3d91` or similar brand blue that meets 4.5:1. I'll add color tokens in the PR. Ellen Wu: Retention numeric input: make sure arrow keys change by 1 day and pages by 10, and screen reader announces units. Use aria-live region to say "Retention set to X days" when changed via keyboard. AccessibilityBot: Example snippet for the toggle and badge: ```html Audit logs will record key-id when enabled. ``` Note: ensure badge receives focus and opens tooltip on Enter/Space. Taylor Reed: Nice. Can we also add a subtle inline hint under region: '(set by org policy)' in bold when enforced? That helps screenshots and reduces mistakes. Priya Nair: One more copy nit for console: change 'Retention: 90' to 'Data retention: 90 days' in the summary panel. Keep units explicit in summaries and CSV exports. Omar Khalid: I'll own the visual token change and PR the updated focus styles + a11y attributes. Ellen, can you update copy for KMS and retention in the console and audit examples? Ellen Wu: Yep. I'll also add examples to our audit doc: https://redwood.internal/compliance/audit-samples and include before/after. Taylor Reed: Plan: bundle the a11y + copy + audit schema change into one PR. Targeting next sprint. Please add the mock screenshots or Figma link in the PR description. Thanks team :rocket:
